en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Hammad, from Ayoub Bin Haroun, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Did Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to part (style) his<sup>saww</sup> hair?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No. Whenever Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> lengthened his<sup>saww</sup> hair, it would be to the lobe of his<sup>saww</sup> ear’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Yahya ibn Harun who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, if the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, parted his hairs. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, the Messenger of Allah would keep his hairs long enough to reach his ear lobe only.’”
